cross_agent_conflicts.issue: history_valid.hlsl (INC-C) and curve.hlsl (INC-B) both define `struct FrexpStructType` with different layouts (INC-C: float mantissa+exponent; INC-B: float3 mantissa + int3 exponent). Any shader including both the bilinear chain (bilinear->history_valid) and the math chain (math->quad_mesh->image->curve) fails to compile. INC-A keeps evidence-based includes; INC-B/INC-C must reconcile the type (rename or merge) for full integration.
cross_agent_conflicts.impact: INC-A compile self-test splits into entry A (curve chain) and entry B (history_valid chain); both PASS individually.

dependency_protocol_notes: INC-A wrote only its owned files under reconstruction/shader-source/shaders/inc/.

Cross-agent includes used at compile time: inc/smooth_max.hlsl (INC-B, reconstructed), inc/history_valid.hlsl (INC-C, reconstructed), inc/unjitter_taa.hlsl (INC-C, reconstructed), inc/curve.hlsl (INC-B, reconstructed). No temp dep copies needed — all deps exist in the tree.
INC-C cascades.hlsl / unjitter_taa.hlsl use bare-global `view_constants[i]` access, matching INC-A's cbuffer member style (verified compilable).
